sources.title: Holographic Complexity Equals Bulk Action?

evidence.text: Test the proposal using null shocks, including multiple shocks and locations, and static surrounding shells. Compare action changes with circuit-complexity expectations, scrambling-time cancellations, and gravitational redshift.

sources.title: Complexity is simple!

evidence.text: Reviews the Margolus-Levitin overlap argument and extends it to approximate orthogonality. Lloyd's operation-counting bound is obtained by applying the orthogonalization-time bound to each elementary gate, including commuting parallel gates.

sources.title: Holographic complexity in string and M theory

evidence.text: Translates higher-dimensional functionals using reduction rules, and computes Chern–Simons gauge variations on finite regions. Supergravity equations of motion turn the required form-field boundary terms into on-shell bulk expressions.

sources.title: Holographic Complexity Equals Bulk Action?

evidence.text: Evaluate the regulated on-shell action of the WDW patch and its time derivative. Neutral and rotating examples require cancellations between Einstein–Hilbert and surface terms; charged examples also involve the Maxwell term. The reported asymptotic divergences are time independent.

sources.title: Complexity is simple!

evidence.text: Estimates thermal-field-double overlaps using a continuum spectral density exp S(E) and a quadratic entropy saddle. This gives Gaussian overlap decay and τcoh = sqrt(-S''(E)); comparison with τcomp = (dC/dt)^(-1) diagnoses a serial gate's action. Charge fluctuations require an entropy-Hessian or Gibbs-free-energy treatment.

sources.title: Holographic complexity in string and M theory

evidence.text: Uses the imported complexity=anything framework: optimize one functional to select a codimension-zero region, then evaluate another functional there. Hypersurface functionals arise as a special case.

sources.title: Quantum Gates to other Universes

evidence.text: Translate linking numbers into five-brane positions, solve leading displacement equations at large separation ξ, and expand the harmonic functions near the strip center. In the symmetric example, the author calculation gives e^(−ξ) ≃ πn/(4N N̂).

sources.title: Revisiting recent progress in the Karch–Randall braneworld

evidence.text: Extremize and minimize generalized entropy over both island I and radiation region R. Use bulk RT surfaces of connected and disconnected topology; DGP terms add brane-boundary area contributions.

sources.title: Constraining braneworlds with entanglement entropy

evidence.text: Extremize bulk area plus brane-intersection contributions: S=min ext[A/(4G_{d+1})+sum_i A_tilde_i/(4G_{b,i})]. Variation gives a bulk Euler–Lagrange ODE and coupling-dependent dynamical endpoint conditions.

sources.title: End of the world brane meets $ T\overline{T} $

evidence.text: Compare the Brown–York stress-tensor trace with the curvature-dependent T T̄ flow equation. Compute bath entropy using replica partition functions, a CHM map for Type I, and hyperbolic-space stress tensors and partition functions for Type II; compare with RT geodesics.

sources.title: Quantum Gates to other Universes

evidence.text: Use the warped-background spin-2 eigenvalue problem and its weighted wavefunction norm. Minimize the mass functional with an interpolating throat wavefunction orthogonal to the constant massless mode; the throat equation is d[cosh⁴(x)dψ/dx]/dx = 0.

sources.title: Quantum Gates to other Universes

evidence.text: Encode quiver data by ordered partitions (ρ, ρ̂). Good quivers satisfy ρT > ρ̂, equivalently strict inequalities between integrated row lengths; gauge ranks are differences of these integrated lengths. A bridge is constructed by moving boxes between adjacent rows.

evidence.text: Direct radial integration uses elementary half-integer Bessel propagators, gamma and incomplete gamma functions, followed by hypergeometric parameter expansions using HypExp. Exchange results involve logarithms and dilogarithms.

sources.title: A compendium of logarithmic corrections in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: For theories expressible in N=2 language, incorporate supersymmetric nonminimal couplings through aE→aE-c, c→0 and b1→b1-c/6. Boundary contributions are treated by holographic renormalization.

sources.title: Mixed gauge-global symmetries, elliptic modes, and black hole thermodynamics in Hořava-Lifshitz gravity

evidence.text: Canonical Hamiltonian analysis uses Poisson brackets and preservation of constraints to obtain an elliptic lapse equation, including acceleration and cosmological-constant terms. The equation must hold on every leaf rather than merely as an automatically propagated initial constraint.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Change coordinates to concentrate resolution near the singular endpoint, transform the equations, and inspect the new spectral tail.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Linearize, impose source behavior, discretize, and check candidate modes against constraints and resolution refinement.

sources.title: Large N field theories, string theory and gravity

evidence.text: What motivates the holographic correspondence between large-N field theories and string/M theory on AdS backgrounds, what evidence tests it, and what can classical or semiclassical gravity calculate about strongly coupled field theories?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Holography replaces selected strongly coupled field-theory questions with gravitational ones. Its classical use invokes large N, strong coupling and weak bulk curvature; these conditions delimit the calculational laboratory discussed in the window.

sources.title: Holography, Supergravity, and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How can subleading holographic anomalies be extracted from superconformal indices, which fields admit consistent truncation on the Lunin–Maldacena background, and what gauge-gravity EFT constraints follow from corrected black-hole extremality and entropy?

sources.title: Quantum gravity on the bulk cone

evidence.text: Can classical bulk-cone singularities from returning bulk null geodesics persist in exact finite-GN holographic correlators, and can their resolution be explained by quantum fluctuations of geometry?

sources.title: Exploring the holographic Swampland

evidence.text: What structure does holography reveal in fibred LVS and DGKT moduli stabilisation, and does the previously proposed negativity of mixed double-trace anomalous dimensions survive these examples?

sources.title: Witten-Veneziano from Green-Schwarz

evidence.text: Can the Witten–Veneziano relation for the η′ mass be obtained holographically by identifying the closed-string mode responsible for generalized Green–Schwarz cancellation of the axial anomaly with the η′?

sources.title: Explorations in Precision Holography and Higher-derivative Supergravity

evidence.text: What controlled subleading holographic information follows from higher-derivative supergravity, and do holographic c-function monotonicity and consistent truncations survive four-derivative corrections?

sources.title: Holographic conformal order in supergravity

evidence.text: The shared setting tests scalar condensates in M2-brane holography through two consistent truncations of four-dimensional gauged supergravity. A real scalar and planar metric describe the candidate ordered thermal states.

sources.title: Holography and Riemann surfaces

evidence.text: How does semiclassical AdS3 holography extend to compact Riemann-surface boundaries of arbitrary genus, and what do the resulting gravitational actions imply for boundary stress tensors, black-hole topology and thermodynamics?

sources.title: The dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Can asymptotic symmetries and scalar boundary correlators support a holographic description of de Sitter quantum gravity by a Euclidean CFT, determine its central charge in three dimensions, and explain how bulk time and the two asymptotic boundaries are encoded?

sources.title: Constant curvature black hole and dual field theory

evidence.text: Can a five-dimensional constant curvature black hole support a holographic stress-tensor calculation on its time-dependent boundary, and how does this geometry relate to Schwarzschild–AdS bubbles of nothing?

sources.title: The phase diagram of confining holographic theories on constant curvature manifolds in the presence of a θ-angle

evidence.text: How do dimensionless curvature and the θ-angle determine acceptable ground-state saddles and phase transitions of confining holographic QFTs, and can the axial sector supply a boundary order parameter?

sources.title: Emergent Spacetime and Holographic CFTs

evidence.text: Which CFTs admit useful weakly coupled holographic descriptions, and why would factorization and CFT consistency naturally lead an observer to introduce AdS fields and Witten diagrams?

sources.title: End of the world perspective to BCFT

evidence.text: How can tension-dependent BCFT2 thermodynamics be combined with the effective JT thermodynamics seen by EOW-brane observers, and what do these observers see when temperature is lowered and the branes meet?

sources.title: Non-relativistic holography from Horava gravity

evidence.text: What bulk gravitational field content and gauge symmetries can holographically represent generic nonrelativistic QFTs with conserved particle number, and can the resulting dictionary reproduce the correlation-function structure required by nonrelativistic conformal symmetry?

sources.title: Holographic partition functions and phases for higher genus Riemann surfaces

evidence.text: How can classical bulk actions and dominant-saddle phase diagrams be computed for holographic CFT partition functions on higher-genus Riemann surfaces, including competition between handlebodies, selected non-handlebodies, and symmetry-breaking saddles?

sources.title: Entanglement entropy in three dimensional gravity

evidence.text: How can regulated geodesic lengths and holographic interval entropies be computed efficiently in topologically complicated pure three-dimensional gravity, and under what conditions can Euclidean calculations justify covariant HRT?

sources.title: Putting the Boot into the Swampland

evidence.text: Can universal holographic data of moduli-stabilised AdS4 vacua, especially LVS, make their quantum-gravity consistency accessible through unitarity and crossing constraints on putative three-dimensional CFT duals?

sources.title: String compactification, effective field theory and holography swampland

evidence.text: What holographic spectra and anomalous-dimension signs arise from fibred LVS and M-theory moduli stabilization, and how do charged-black-hole Wheeler–DeWitt states connect interiors, boundary partition functions and horizon thermodynamics?

sources.title: Effective action, spectrum and first law of wedge holography

evidence.text: What effective brane action, vector/graviton spectrum, Weyl anomaly and entanglement first law arise in wedge holography beyond its previously studied special solutions?

sources.title: End of the world brane meets $ T\overline{T} $

evidence.text: How can an EOW brane and a finite Dirichlet cutoff coexist in AdS gravity, and does partial reduction produce a gravitational system with a nonconformal T T̄ bath whose entropies and Page curves agree between island and holographic prescriptions?
